title: feat(nm2holyzrd): neighbor-read of yz-plane cyclic-frame holonomy at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Neighbour-read of yz-plane holonomy: enumerates the six lattice translates of each square and reports which translate holds (+e_3 and -e_3 hold for the reverse square, -e_1 alone for the face square). The band's only spatial census of where the split field supports a closed square.
